invariant: idx ≤ min str1.length str2.length ∧ str1.take idx = str2.take idx
guard: idx < min str1.length str2.length ∧ str1[idx]! = str2[idx]!

lemmas.name: step71
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l1 l2 : List Char) (idx : Nat), (idx ≤ min l1.length l2.length ∧ l1.take idx = l2.take idx) → (idx < min l1.length l2.length ∧ l1[idx]! = l2[idx]!) → (idx + 1 ≤ min l1.length l2.length ∧ l1.take (idx + 1) = l2.take (idx + 1))
lemmas.proof:
by intro l1 l2 idx ⟨_, h⟩ ⟨hl, he⟩
  have h1 : idx < l1.length := by omega
  have h2 : idx < l2.length := by omega
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [Refine.take_succ_bang l1 idx h1, Refine.take_succ_bang l2 idx h2, h, he]
